frozen_body: In the conventional four-dimensional spinor-vector description W04a represents a complex vector as a map from the dual right spinor to the left spinor; Minkowski reality relates the two chiralities by conjugation whereas Euclidean signature leaves them independent.

reconstruction.source_reality_summary: Minkowski ties left/right roles through the conjugate-diagonal real form; Euclidean retains independent SU(2)_L and SU(2)_R real-form roles.

guards: No canonical S_R≈S_R* identification is added.
The later distinguished-vector isomorphism W138 is not used to erase the conventional Euclidean independence statement.
No Lisi or cross-track semantics are used.
